Report of the Standing Committee

The committee met to consider the applications received during the term, and records below the numbers it agreed at that meeting. The figures are given by section, and the committee notes that the delivery section had the fewest applications outstanding at the close of the period.

Section Applications Outstanding Design 148 12

Delivery 203 4

Records 96 31

The committee agreed that the figures above should be published with the minutes, and that the records section would be asked for an explanation of the number outstanding before the next meeting is called.
